summary: Sunt Förnuft is a Swedish-language finance magazine published in Stockholm, Sweden. It is owned by the Swedish Taxpayers Association and was founded in 1921, making it one of the oldest magazines in the country.
one_line: Sunt Förnuft is a Swedish-language finance magazine founded in 1921 in Stockholm and owned by the Swedish Taxpayers Association.
key_facts: Sunt Förnuft is a Swedish language finance magazine.
The title Sunt Förnuft means "Common Sense" in English.
Sunt Förnuft is published in Stockholm, Sweden.
Sunt Förnuft is owned by the Swedish Taxpayers Association.
Sunt Förnuft is described as one of the oldest magazines in Sweden.
